maintenanceItems.name: Engine oil
maintenanceItems.symptomsIfNeglected: Sooted oil, timing-chain wear, turbo wear, low pressure

fluid.specification: 5W-40 diesel engine oil, ACEA B4 (or ACEA B3/B4) and API CF/CF-4 or higher. Practical Europe shelf choice: 5W-40 fully/semi-synthetic diesel oil meeting ACEA B4.
fluid.capacity: Approx. 9.8 L total including filter and oil cooler.
fluid.serviceFill: Buy 10 L. Fill gradually and set final level by dipstick after warm-up and drain-back.
fluid.shelfLabel: 5W-40 diesel oil, ACEA B4 / API CF or higher
fluid.avoid: Do not buy petrol-only oil, low-SAPS DPF-only oil without ACEA B4 suitability, or oil that does not list a diesel API/ACEA rating.

parts.note: Use together with oil; alternatives in separate oil-filter item.
Replace only if damaged/rounded; normally washer only is enough.

appNotes: Recommended app interval: 10,000 km / 12 months. Official interval kept separately.

mainParts: 10 L 5W-40 diesel oil, ACEA B4 / API CF or higher
Oil filter ME013307
sealsWashersHardware: Drain plug washer MD050317
Optional drain plug MD050316 if damaged
replacementChecklist.notes: Normal oil service kit: oil + filter + washer. Drain plug itself is not normally replaced unless damaged.
